create_luke_config: create a LukeConfig instance with default hyperparameters for the LUKE model
configure_luke_model: configure a LukeConfig with custom entity_vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
initialize_luke_model: initialize a LukeModel using a LukeConfig configuration object
access_luke_config: access the model configuration from a LukeModel instance via model.config
customize_luke_attention: customize LukeConfig to enable or disable entity_aware_attention mechanism
